appearance.heading: Ukubukeka
appearance.description: Kwesimanje kuyinto ezenzakalelayo: ukwakheka okujwayelekile kwengxoxo ngombhalo olinganiselwe. Itheminali ingukubukeka kwe-monospace kwesitayela se-IRC ongakukhetha. Kuyavumelana kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho.
appearance.skinModernDetail: Umbhalo olinganiselwe, izithombe nemigqa enendawo eyanele

firstRun.title: Khetha ukuthi i-Pollis ibukeka kanjani
firstRun.subtitle: Khetha ukubukeka ozoqala ngakho. Ungakushintsha noma nini ku-Okuthandayo, futhi kuyavumelana kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho.
firstRun.saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza ukukhetha kwakho. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.

display.heading: Isibonisi (le divayisi)
display.fontSizeNote: Usayizi wefonti ungowedivayisi ngayinye — ngeke uvumelaniswe namanye amadivayisi akho.
display.fontSizeSample: Inja ensundu esheshayo yeqa phezu kwekati elivilaphayo.
display.callRingtoneDescription: Idlala ukukhala okuphindaphindayo kule divayisi uma othile eshayela. Ukuvala lapha akuthulisi ibheji lesexwayiso noma amanye amadivayisi akho.

layout.heading: Ukwakheka
layout.sidebarDescription: Ilawula ukuthi ibha eseceleni kwesobunxele ivuliwe yini uma uhlelo lokusebenza luqala. Shintsha noma nini nge-{{shortcut}}.
layout.rightPanelDescription: Amalungu nemidiya eyabiwe yesiteshi noma yengxoxo oyibukayo. Kukhunjulwa kule divayisi ku-akhawunti yakho — kuhlala njengoba ukushiyile ngenkathi uzulazula kuhlelo lokusebenza, futhi akukulandeli kwamanye amadivayisi akho. Kushintshe noma nini nge-{{shortcut}}.
layout.closeToTrayDescription: Uma kuvuliwe, ukuvala iwindi kufihla i-Pollis kuthileyi yesistimu esikhundleni sokuyivala. Chofoza kwesokudla isithonjana sethileyi ukuze uvale. Uma indawo yakho yedeskithophu ingakhombisi izithonjana zethileyi (i-GNOME engenayo isandiso se-AppIndicator), kuvale lokhu.
layout.menubarIconDescription: Yengeza isithonjana se-Pollis kubha yemenyu ye-macOS (phezulu kwesokudla). Sichofoze ukuze uvule iwindi, uthulise imakrofoni uma usekholini, noma uvale uhlelo lokusebenza. Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo — isithonjana se-dock sesivele sigcina i-Pollis ifinyeleleka uma iwindi livaliwe.

notifications.heading: Izaziso
notifications.callTakeoverDescription: Uma othile ekushayela ku-DM, ikholi ithatha isikrini sonke ngokuthi Yamukela nokuthi Yenqaba, bese ikubuyisela lapho ubukhona. Uma kuvaliwe: isexwayiso sebha yesimo, ithoni yokukhala nesaziso kusafika njengokujwayelekile.

readReceipts.heading: Izaziso zokufundwa
readReceipts.description: Emilayezweni eqondile, kuvumela abantu oxoxa nabo ukuthi babone ukuthi imilayezo yabo ifike nini kudivayisi yakho nokuthi uyifunde nini. Ukukuvala lokhu kuphinde kufihle izaziso zabo kuwe — ngeke usabona ukuthi imilayezo yakho ilethiwe noma ifundiwe. Izaziso zibethelwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni njenganoma yimuphi umlayezo; amaseva ethu awalokothi abone ukuthi ubani ofunde ini. Iziteshi zamaqembu azilokothi zithumele izaziso.

retention.heading: Umlando wemilayezo wasendaweni
retention.description: Ilawula ukuthi mungakanani umlando wemilayezo ogcinwa kule divayisi. Imilayezo emidala isuswa esitoreji sasendaweni ukuze konge isikhala. Lokhu akuthinti amanye amadivayisi akho noma abantu oxoxa nabo, futhi uzoqhubeka uthola imilayezo emisha njengokujwayelekile.

overlay.heading: Ubumfihlo benethiwekhi (i-relay)
overlay.description: Idlulisa ithrafikhi ye-Pollis uqobo (imilayezo, ukuvumelanisa) nge-relay ukuze amaseva ethu abone ikheli le-relay, hhayi elakho. Amakholi axhuma ngqo. Lokhu kufihla i-IP yakho ku-Pollis — akukona ukungaziwa, futhi akushintshi ukubethela kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni.
overlay.itemPrefer: <mode>Ncamela</mode> — Sebenzisa i-relay uma itholakala; buyela kuxhumano oluqondile uma ingatholakali.
overlay.itemStrict: <mode>Okuqinile</mode> — Xhuma nge-relay kuphela. Uma ingekho i-relay efinyelelekayo, ukuthumela kuyamiswa kunokuba kuvezwe i-IP yakho.

linkPreviews.heading: Ukubuka kuqala kwezixhumanisi
linkPreviews.label: Dala ukubuka kuqala kwezixhumanisi
linkPreviews.description: Uma uthumela isixhumanisi, i-Pollis ilanda ikhasi isuka kule divayisi ukuze idale ukubuka kuqala. Isayithi ibona ikheli lakho le-IP, njengokungathi ulivule wena. Abantu obathumelayo abaxhumani nesayithi neze.
linkPreviews.strictNote: Ubumfihlo benethiwekhi obuqinile buvala ukubuka kuqala kwezixhumanisi.

relayServing.heading: Qhuba i-relay yokusiza abanye
relayServing.intro: Lokhu kuwukukhetha okuhlukile kwesilungiselelo esingenhla. Leso sinquma ukuthi ithrafikhi <dim>yakho</dim> idlula nge-relay yini. Lesi sinquma ukuthi ithrafikhi <dim>yabanye abantu</dim> idlula <dim>kudivayisi yakho</dim> yini. Ukuvula noma yisiphi akulokothi kuvule esinye.
relayServing.enabledDescription: Kuvaliwe ngaphandle uma ukuvula. Ungakuvala futhi noma nini.
relayServing.wouldDoBody: Idlulisela ithrafikhi yabanye abantu esivele ibethelwe kumaseva e-Pollis uqobo, ngakho lawo maseva abona ikheli lakho kuleyo thrafikhi esikhundleni sabo. Idivayisi yakho idlulisela kuphela kumaseva e-Pollis — ayilokothi idlulisele kwawomunye umuntu, futhi ayilokothi idlulisele ku-inthanethi evulekile.
relayServing.wouldSeeBody: Lutho. Ukudlulisa akunikezi ukufinyelela kokufunda kwanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Okudlulayo kuwukusakaza okuvalwe uphawu idivayisi yakho engenaye ukhiye wako: awukwazi ukufunda imilayezo, amafayela noma amakholi, awukwazi ukubona ukuthi ubani owakuthumela noma okwakhe, futhi awukwazi ukuhlukanisa uhlobo olulodwa lwethrafikhi nolunye. Okuwukuphela kwento idivayisi yakho ekufundayo ukuthi iklayenti elithile le-Pollis lishintshisana ngamabhayithi abethelwe neseva ye-Pollis. Futhi awukwazi ukushintsha lutho olusendleleni — ukuphazamisa kuphula uxhumano kuphela, bese umthumeli edlula ngenye indlela.
relayServing.costBody: Umkhawulokudonsa, futhi — ngaphandle kwemibandela engezansi — ibhethri nedatha ekhokhelwayo.
relayServing.exactBody: Ukuze sicacise ngalokho ukudlulisa okukuthengayo: kufihla amakheli e-IP kumaseva ethu. Yilokho kuphela. Akukona ukungaziwa, akukona ukuzivikela kumuntu ongabuka zombili izingxenye zoxhumano, futhi akufihli ukuthi ubani okhuluma nobani — amaseva ethu asakubona lokho ku-akhawunti eyenza isicelo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi i-relay ikhona noma ayikho. Futhi akukona okwenza i-Pollis ibethelwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni: imilayezo yakho ibethelwa kudivayisi ethumelayo noma ngabe ukhona noma akekho osebenzisa i-relay. Ukudlulisa kuwukuvikelwa kwemethadatha okubekwe ngaphansi kwalesi siqinisekiso, akulokothi kube ubufakazi baso.
relayServing.wifiOnlyDescription: Iyeka ukudlulisa kudatha yeselula, noma kunoma yiluphi uxhumano idivayisi yakho eluveza njengolukhokhelwayo. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
relayServing.powerOnlyDescription: Iyeka ukudlulisa ngenkathi le divayisi isebenza ngebhethri. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
relayServing.statusUnreportable: le nguqulo ayikwazi ukuveza isimo se-relay, ngakho i-Pollis ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le divayisi iyadlulisa yini.
relayServing.statusServing_one: iyadlulisa — ithwele uxhumano olungu-{{count}}, {{bytes}} kudluliselwe selokhu i-Pollis yaqala.
relayServing.statusServing_other: iyadlulisa — ithwele uxhumano olungu-{{count}}, {{bytes}} kudluliselwe selokhu i-Pollis yaqala.
relayServing.holdNoInboundPath: kumisiwe — amanye amadivayisi awakwazi ukufinyelela le nge-nethiwekhi yakho
relayServing.applyError: Ayikwazanga ukusebenzisa lokhu kuhlelo lokusebenza olusebenzayo: {{error}}. Ukukhetha kwakho kulondoloziwe futhi kuzosebenza uma isevisi ye-relay isifinyeleleka.

user.handleHint: Amanye amalungu angakuthola futhi akuthumelele i-DM nge-@isibambo.
user.handleInvalid: Izibambo zinezinhlamvu ezingu-3–32: izinhlamvu ezincane, amadijithi, '_', '.' noma '-'.
user.currentCodeSent: Siphinde sathumela ikhodi ku-<addr>{{email}}</addr>. Ukushintsha ikheli lakho kufanele kuvunywe kusuka ekhelini olishiyayo.
user.currentCodeRequired: Faka ikhodi ethunyelwe ekhelini lakho le-imeyili lamanje.
user.avatarHint: PNG, JPG, GIF — kuze kufike ku-5MB

security.title: Ukuphepha
security.eventDeviceRevokedDetail: Idivayisi {{device}} yaphumiswa futhi yasuswa ku-akhawunti yakho.
security.eventDeviceRevokedDetailUnknown: Idivayisi ethile yaphumiswa futhi yasuswa ku-akhawunti yakho.
security.eventIdentityResetDetail: Usethe kabusha i-akhawunti yakho. Wonke amadivayisi namaqembu angaphambilini asele engenamnikazi.
security.eventIdentityRotatedDetailSession: Umazisi omusha we-akhawunti wakhiwe kusuka kudivayisi ephumile kusetshenziswa ikhodi ye-imeyili. Wonke amadivayisi namaqembu angaphambilini asusiwe.
security.eventIdentityRotatedDetailSignature: Umazisi omusha we-akhawunti wakhiwe kusuka kwenye yamadivayisi akho abhalisiwe.
security.eventSecretKeyRotatedDetail: Ukhiye Oyimfihlo wakho ushintshiwe. Omdala awusasebenzi.
security.eventEmailChangedDetail: I-akhawunti ithuthwe isuka ku-{{from}} yaya ku-{{to}}. Womabili amakheli kwakufanele akuqinisekise.
security.accountKeyDescription: Ukhiye womazisi wakho ushicilelwe kurekhodi lokusobala elisesidlangalaleni, elingangezwa kuphela, ukuze noma ubani aqinisekise ukuthi oxhumana nabo bakhuluma nawe ngempela. Lokhu kuhlola ukuthi irekhodi liyavumelana yini nokhiye okule divayisi.
security.thisBuildDescription: Yonke inguqulo i-Pollis eyikhiphayo ifakwa uphawu lweminwe kulelo rekhodi elifanayo elisesidlangalaleni, elingangezwa kuphela. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi inguqulo oyisebenzisayo ingeyodwa i-Pollis eyishicilele lapho; izinguqulo ze-Linux nazo zakhiwa kabusha ngokuzimela kusuka kumthombo futhi zihlolwe ngakuyo. Lokhu ngokwako akufakazeli ukuthi inguqulo ifana nomthombo, ngoba uhlelo lokusebenza oluphazanyisiwe lungaqamba amanga ngophawu lweminwe lwalo.
security.buildVerifyError: Ayikwazanga ukuhlola le nguqulo manje. Zama futhi emzuzwini.
security.pinDescription: I-PIN yasendaweni ivula i-Pollis kule divayisi. Ayilokothi ishiye idivayisi futhi ayikwazi ukubuyiswa — sebenzisa Ukhiye Oyimfihlo wakho uma uyikhohlwa.
security.autoLockDescription: Khiya i-Pollis ibuyele esikrinini se-PIN ngemuva kwesikhathi esithile kungekho msebenzi wegundane noma wekhibhodi, ukuze ukusuka kulo mshini kungashiyi izingxoxo zakho ezingasabethelwe zibonakala esikrinini. Ungahlala ukhiya ngokushesha nge-{{shortcut}}.
security.autoLockNote: Kusebenza kule divayisi kuphela. Ikholi eqhubekayo igcina i-Pollis ivuliwe — ukukhiya bekuzovala imininingwane yasendaweni ngaphansi kwekholi. Akukho okulahlekayo uma ikhiya: imilayezo yakho isediskini, futhi ukufaka i-PIN yakho kukubuyisela khona manjalo.
security.devicesDescription: Yonke idivayisi engene ku-akhawunti yakho. Hoxisa noma iyiphi ongayazi — idivayisi ilahlekelwa ukufinyelela kuwo wonke amaqembu nama-DM uma iphinde ivumelanisa.
security.eventsDescription: Njalo uma idivayisi yengezwa ku-akhawunti yakho, idivayisi ihoxiswa, ukubhalisa kwenqatshwa, noma umazisi wakho usethwa kabusha, kuvela lapha. Kuhlole uma kwenzeka usola ukuthi othile ufinyelele i-akhawunti yakho.
security.revokeMediaOnExitLabel: Hoxisa izimvume zesistimu uma i-Pollis ivalwa
security.revokeMediaOnExitDescription: Uma kuvuliwe, i-Pollis isula izimvume zayo ezilondoloziwe zekhamera / zemakrofoni / zesikrini uma ivalwa, ukuze i-OS iphinde ibuze ngokuzayo.
security.mediaNoteMac: Isula imvume elondoloziwe ye-Pollis; i-macOS izophinde ibuze ngokuzayo uma usebenzisa isici ngasinye.
security.mediaNoteLinux: I-Linux inikeza ukufinyelela kwemidiya ngeseshini ngayinye — i-Pollis ayigcini mvume ehlala njalo, ngakho akukho okungahoxiswa lapha.
security.mediaNoteWindows: Isimo sekhamera nemakrofoni sivela kuzilungiselelo zobumfihlo ze-Windows. “Hoxisa manje” kuvula lezo zilungiselelo ukuze ukwazi ukuvala i-Pollis; ukwabelana ngesikrini akulandelwa lapho.
security.mediaNoteOther: Izilawuli zezimvume zemidiya azitholakali kule nkundla.
security.terminalEnabledDescription: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma kuvuliwe, iphaneli yetheminali ingaqala i-shell yakho yokungena nemvelo yakho egcwele — amandla afanayo nokuzivulela iTheminali. Kushiye kuvaliwe ngaphandle uma ukusebenzisa.
security.exportDescription: Londoloza konke okuphethwe yile divayisi (imilayezo, izinto ezilondoloziwe, isiphephelo) efayeleni. Akukho okulayishwayo.
security.exportNote: Idivayisi ngayinye igcina umlando wayo, ngakho khiphela kuleyo enawo.
security.exportFetchNote: Okunye okunamathiselwe akukho kule divayisi. Ukukulanda kuthola ngakunye kuseva — okuwukuphela kwesinyathelo lapha esixhuma ku-inthanethi.
security.dangerZoneDescription: Susa unomphela i-akhawunti yakho nayo yonke idatha ehlobene nayo. Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.
security.eventRecoveryBlobFetchedDetail: Idivayisi ethile ingene ngekhodi yakho ye-imeyili futhi yalanda isipele se-akhawunti yakho esibethelwe ukuze isibuyise ngoKhiye Oyimfihlo wakho. Isipele asikwazi ukuvulwa ngaphandle kwalowo khiye.
security.eventHistoryTransferApprovedDetail: Uvumele idivayisi {{device}} ukuthi ikopishe umlando wemilayezo yakho.
security.eventHistoryTransferApprovedDetailUnknow: Uvumele enye yamadivayisi akho ukuthi ikopishe umlando wemilayezo yakho.
security.eventHistoryTransferCompletedDetail: Umlando wemilayezo ukopishwe phakathi kwamadivayisi ale akhawunti ({{device}}).
security.eventHistoryTransferCompletedDetailUnkno: Umlando wemilayezo ukopishwe phakathi kwamadivayisi ale akhawunti.

changePin.hintOld: Faka i-PIN yakho yamanje enamadijithi angu-4 ukuze uqhubeke.
changePin.hintConfirm: Faka i-PIN entsha futhi ukuze uqinisekise.

update.title: Isibuyekezo Sesofthiwe
update.heading: Isibuyekezo Sesofthiwe
update.managedNote: Lokhu kufakwa kuphethwe ngu-{{manager}}. I-Pollis ayikwazi ukuzibuyekeza ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza — sebenzisa isiphathi samaphakheji sakho, bese uyiqala kabusha.

notify.enrollmentBody: Idivayisi entsha icela ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti yakho

searchIndex.heading: Inkomba yokusesha imilayezo
searchIndex.description: Ukusesha kwenzeka ngokuphelele kule divayisi, kusetshenziswa inkomba egcinwe ngaphakathi kwemininingwane yasendaweni ebethelwe. Iyazilungisa uma kuqala uhlelo uma kwenzeka kukhona okungahambanga kahle; yakhe kabusha ngesandla kuphela uma usesho lungatholi imilayezo owaziyo ukuthi ikhona lapha.

linkDevice.heading: Xhuma idivayisi entsha
linkDevice.rowSub: Ngena kwenye ifoni, ithebhulethi, noma ikhompyutha
linkDevice.showSubtitle: Kudivayisi entsha, thepha okuthi Ngena ngenye idivayisi.
linkDevice.codeSubtitle: Kopisha le khodi bese uyinamathisela kudivayisi entsha.
linkDevice.approveHint: Vuma kuphela idivayisi osanda kuyisetha. Izokwazi ukufunda imilayezo yakho.
linkDevice.tampered: Lesi sicelo sishintshile sisendleleni, ngakho asikwazi ukuvunywa. Zama futhi ngekhodi entsha.
linkDevice.expired: Amakhodi ahlala umzuzu owodwa. Thola entsha ukuze uzame futhi.

diagnostics.title: Ukuhlolwa Kwenkinga
diagnostics.intro: Irekhodi lalokho i-Pollis ekwenzile kule divayisi, njengokungena, izinkinga zoxhumano namaphutha. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, ukwabelana ngalo kusisiza ukuthola imbangela.
diagnostics.privacy: Alilokothi lifake imilayezo yakho, amagama amafayela, okhiye noma amaphasiwedi, futhi amakheli e-imeyili nawenethiwekhi ayafihlwa. Lihlala kule divayisi ngaphandle uma wabelana ngalo.
diagnostics.trimmed: Kukhonjiswa okufakwe kamuva kakhulu. Ukulanda kulondoloza irekhodi eliphelele.

openSource.title: Amalayisensi omthombo ovulekile
openSource.intro: I-Pollis yakhelwe phezu kwesofthiwe yomthombo ovulekile. Yonke iphakheji yezinkampani zangaphandle kule nguqulo ibhalwe nelayisensi yayo; khetha eyodwa ukuze ufunde umbhalo welayisensi.
openSource.unavailable: Uhlu lwamalayisensi lwenziwa uma uhlelo lokusebenza lwakhiwa, futhi le nguqulo yokuthuthukisa ayinalo.
openSource.notFound: Le phakheji ayiyona ingxenye yale nguqulo.

aliases.heading: Amagama okuzisholo eqembu
aliases.intro: Bonisa igama nesithombe esihlukile eqenjini ngalinye. I-@gama lakho lomsebenzisi lihlala lifana yonke indawo.
aliases.pageIntro: Yileli qembu kuphela elibona leli gama nalesi sithombe. Imilayezo eqondile igcina iphrofayela yakho eyinhloko.
aliases.nameInvalid: Kuze kufike ezinhlamvwini eziyi-100, ngaphandle kuka-< noma u->.
aliases.applyAllHint: Ibhala igama noma isithombe osishintshile kulo lonke iqembu okulo manje. Amaqembu ozojoyina kamuva aqala ngephrofayela yakho eyinhloko.
